verdict.rationale: Caption export is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions SRT, VTT, or any caption or subtitle output format. Batch, realtime, diarization and translation features are documented, but none of them covers caption export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export a transcript as SRT or VTT captions through the API or a documented path
